<div class="card-body">
'''Dack Ralter''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ダク・ロルター</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">宇宙船に乗客として搭乗しているなら宇宙船の兵器の武器運命数に１を加える。ローグ１にルークとともに搭乗しているなら武器運命数に３を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Dack-Ralter-PSA-148375103.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">カリスト６にある帝国の労働キャンプで生まれた。キャンプを脱走して反乱軍に参加。スカイ・ウォーカー中佐の弟分で、経験豊富な名砲手。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Dack Ralter.

'''Card text:'''
If aboard a starship as a passenger, adds 1 to that starship's weapon destiny. Adds 3 to weapon destiny if aboard Rogue 1 with Luke.

'''Lore:'''
Born in an Imperial labor camp on Kalist 6. He escaped the camp and joined the Rebellion. Commander Skywalker's junior, and an experienced crack gunner.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese adds 3 only aboard Rogue 1 with Luke; the English if aboard Rogue 1 or with Luke.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Dack Ralter]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
